summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests banked allogeneic C7R-modified CD30 CAR Epstein-Barr virus-specific T cells (C7R.CD30.CAR-EBVST) in people with relapsed or refractory CD30-positive lymphomas. The cells are given by IV infusion on Day 0 over about 1 to 10 minutes, at one of four dose levels, and how often they are repeated is not stated. The study aims to assess safety and effectiveness, but no specific primary outcome measure is stated; the study is Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa linfocitos T específicos para el virus de Epstein-Barr, de donante y almacenados en banco, modificados con C7R y con el receptor CD30 CAR (C7R.CD30.CAR-EBVST), en personas con linfomas CD30 positivos recidivantes o refractarios. Las células se administran por infusión intravenosa el Día 0, durante aproximadamente 1 a 10 minutos, en uno de cuatro niveles de dosis; no se indica con qué frecuencia se repiten. El estudio busca evaluar la seguridad y la eficacia, pero no se indica una medida principal de resultado específica; el estudio es de fase 1.

Tumor tests CD30-positive in a CLIA-certified pathology laboratory.
Adequate liver, kidney and oxygen levels, and Karnofsky or Lansky score above 60%.
Recovered from acute side effects of prior chemotherapy, and signed informed consent.
not_for: Investigational cell therapy or vaccine within the past 6 weeks.
Investigational small molecule drug within the past 2 weeks, or anti-CD30 antibody therapy within 4 weeks.
Tumor location where enlargement could block the airway, high-dose steroids, active uncontrolled infection, or NYHA class III or IV heart disease.
